samples.plain: single text answer with partial message deltas
samples.tool: one Bash tool call and result, then the answer

samples.control: real capture of the interactive permission exchange, executable 2.1.266 on 2026-09-09: claude -p --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages --permission-mode default --max-turns 3 --permission-prompt-tool stdio --permission-prompts host, the brief as a user line on stdin, a scripted loopback endpoint answering a Bash tool_use, the control_request answered with an allow control_response, the correlated tool_result, the answer and the result; sanitized (cwd, home, socket path)
